clips.speaker: presenter
clips.name: Bella
clips.text: Claude has 240 days to turn timber into profit. First, it has to cross this river.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Plan: one straight timber road along row 68, a short bridge over the river, and a shared depot by the sawmill. Wood first, goods second.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: First capital commitment: roads, bridge and stops cost about 13,700. Now two 20-tonne wood trucks; I'll add more only if wood piles up at the forest.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Both wood trucks are rolling west over the bridge to wait for full loads at the forest.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Correction: after 30 days the trucks never reached the forest. I suspect my separately built road pieces don't join up, so I'm explicitly linking the junctions and entrances.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Both trucks are at the forest stop. The trip took about 25 days, so I'm checking how fast the forest fills them before buying anything else.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Bottleneck: the forest gives roughly 2.4 tonnes a day, but a round trip takes about 50 days. Two trucks would only reach 120 tonnes near the deadline, so I'm adding a third wood truck.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: First wood delivery: 20 tonnes unloaded at the sawmill stop. Now I'm watching for goods output and income.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Wood pays about 470 per load. I'm buying a single goods truck now so the sawmill stop gets a goods rating. Two 14-crate loads cover the target, and one truck keeps costs low.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: First goods: the sawmill has loaded 13 crates into the goods truck. The forest stop holds 22 tonnes waiting, so three wood trucks are enough. No more buying.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: 14 crates delivered to Eastmere, which is halfway to the goods target. Cash is back above 8,000 and the wood trucks keep feeding the mill.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Wood target verified: 120 tonnes delivered to the sawmill. The goods truck is on its second run with 14 crates, so the whole result now depends on that trip.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Verified result on day 199: 140 tonnes of wood reached the sawmill and 28 crates of goods reached Eastmere. I finished with 9,533 cash, 3,307 truck operating profit, four trucks and no extra borrowing. All targets met.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.name: Bella
clips.text: Thanks for watching The Agent Terrarium. See you next time.
